description: INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS.VIEW_DEFINITION and SHOW VIEWS' text carry a view's FULL executable CREATE statement exactly as typed (original case, no normalization, no qualification, no added OR REPLACE) - deployment tooling EXECUTE IMMEDIATEs that text, so a bare SELECT there silently no-ops the recreate. The verbatim text re-executes when the original said OR REPLACE, SECURE and explicit column lists survive, SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS' text is the full DDL too, GET_DDL stays bare-named with its rendered output column list, and the scripting fetch-into-variable + EXECUTE IMMEDIATE recreate loop works. Converted 1:1 from ddl/ViewDefinitionDdlTest (now retired).

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE orders (id INTEGER, amount NUMBER(10,2))
CREATE VIEW big_orders AS SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100
SELECT view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_name = 'BIG_ORDERS'

rows: CREATE VIEW big_orders AS SELECT id, amount FROM orders WHERE amount > 100

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE customers (id INTEGER, name VARCHAR)
INSERT INTO customers VALUES (1, 'a'), (2, 'b')
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW customer_names AS SELECT name FROM customers
SET ddl = (SELECT view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_name = 'CUSTOMER_NAMES')
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $ddl
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_names
CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER, price NUMBER)
CREATE OR REPLACE SECURE VIEW priced (pid, cost) AS SELECT id, price FROM products
SELECT view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_name = 'PRICED'

rows: CREATE OR REPLACE SECURE VIEW priced (pid, cost) AS SELECT id, price FROM products

steps.sql: SET ddl = (SELECT view_definition FROM information_schema.views WHERE table_name = 'PRICED')
EXECUTE IMMEDIATE $ddl
CREATE TABLE emp (id INTEGER)
CREATE VIEW emp_view AS SELECT id FROM emp
SHOW VIEWS
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'EMP_VIEW', "text", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))

expect.value: CREATE VIEW emp_view AS SELECT id FROM emp

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE dept (id INTEGER)
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW dept_mv AS SELECT id FROM dept
SHOW MATERIALIZED VIEWS
SELECT MAX(IFF("name" = 'DEPT_MV', "text", NULL)) FROM TABLE(RESULT_SCAN(LAST_QUERY_ID()))

expect.value: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW dept_mv AS SELECT id FROM dept
